<p>If you use Google Analytics to monitor your project’s traffic, you can view the results of your Optimizely experiments alongside the rest of the data that <a href="https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/" target="" title="">Google Analytics</a> collects.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="configure-ga4-in-feature-experimentation"></div><div class="heading-text">Configure GA4 in Feature Experimentation</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Configure GA4 in Feature Experimentation" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#configure-ga4-in-feature-experimentation"></a></h2>
<p>You can use a custom notification listener to configure GA4 in Optimizely Feature Experimentation. <a href="/docs/notification-listeners" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="notification-listeners">Notification listeners</a> let you programmatically observe and act on various events within the SDKs.</p>
<p>For information on how to configure a notification listener, select the corresponding SDK to view the developer documentation:</p>

<li><a href="/docs/set-up-notification-listener-javascript" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="set-up-notification-listener-javascript">JavaScript (Browser) SDK</a> – SDK versions 5.3.5 and below</li>

<li><a href="/docs/set-up-a-notification-listener-using-the-react-native-sdk" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="set-up-a-notification-listener-using-the-react-native-sdk">React Native SDK</a></li>

<blockquote class="callout callout_info" theme="📘"><span class="callout-icon">📘</span><h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="note"></div><div class="heading-text">Note</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Note" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#note"></a></h3><p>The following examples use the JavaScript (Browser) SDK.</p></blockquote>
<p>Example <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">onDecision</code> listener.</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-undefined"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="javascript">JavaScript</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">const {
  createInstance,
  createPollingProjectConfigManager,
  NOTIFICATION_TYPES
} = require("@optimizely/optimizely-sdk");


const projectConfigManager = createPollingProjectConfigManager({
	sdkKey: ""
})

const optimizely = createInstance({
	projectConfigManager
});

const onDecision = ({ type, userId, attributes, decisionInfo }) => {
  // Add a DECISION Notification Listener for type FLAG
  if (type === 'flag') {
    // Access information about feature, for example, key and enabled status
    console.log(decisionInfo['flagKey']);
    console.log(decisionInfo['enabled']);
    console.log(decisionInfo['decisionEventDispatched']);
    if (decisionInfo['decisionEventDispatched']) {
      // Send data to analytics provider here
    }
  }
}

const notificationId = optimizely.notificationCenter.addNotificationListener(
  NOTIFICATION_TYPES.DECISION,
  onDecision
);</code></pre></div></div>
<blockquote class="callout callout_info" theme="📘"><span class="callout-icon">📘</span><h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="note-1"></div><div class="heading-text">Note</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Note" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#note-1"></a></h3><p>The notification listener returns the decision. It is possible to update what is returned by editing the <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">onDecision</code> notification listener. Review the <a href="/docs/decision-notification-listener" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="decision-notification-listener">Decision notifications listeners</a> developer documentation for information.</p></blockquote>
<p>Example of a <strong>targeted delivery</strong> <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">decisionInfo</code> object.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/27a6ae2-new-targeted-delivery-decisionInfo.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<p>Example of an <strong>experiment</strong> <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">decisionInfo</code> object.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/d840139-new-experiment-decisionInfo.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<p>You can distinguish between a <a href="/docs/run-flag-deliveries" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="run-flag-deliveries">flag delivery (targeted delivery)</a> or an experiment (<a href="/docs/run-a-b-tests" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="run-a-b-tests">A/B test</a> or <a href="/docs/run-a-mab-optimization" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="run-a-mab-optimization">multi-armed bandit optimization</a>) based on <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">decisionEventDispatched</code>. An experiment has this value set to <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">true</code>. A targeted delivery returns <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">false</code>, as there is no dispatched event for rollouts. See the <a href="/docs/configure-event-dispatcher-javascript" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="configure-event-dispatcher-javascript">decision event dispatched parameter</a> developer documentation for information.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="integrate-with-or-without-google-tag-manager"></div><div class="heading-text">Integrate with or without Google Tag Manager</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Integrate with or without Google Tag Manager" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#integrate-with-or-without-google-tag-manager"></a></h2>
<p>You can configure the integration between Optimizely and GA4 with or without Google Tag Manager (GTM). You should use GTM to track the data and variables sent by Optimizely, as it makes timing issues much more manageable.</p>
<p>GTM lets you push items to GTM’s data layer even while the integration end object is unavailable, such as the Google Analytics (GA) object. Using GTM is especially useful if you run a back-end experiment and pass that information to your front-end to send it to GA.</p>
<p>Alternatively, configuring GA4 without GTM requires manually tracking the events and variables sent by Optimizely and verifying that they are sent after GA is initialized.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="with-google-tag-manager"></div><div class="heading-text">With Google Tag Manager</div><a aria-label="Skip link to With Google Tag Manager" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#with-google-tag-manager"></a></h2>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="push-optimizely-data-to-google-tag-manager"></div><div class="heading-text">Push Optimizely data to Google Tag Manager</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Push Optimizely data to Google Tag Manager" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#push-optimizely-data-to-google-tag-manager"></a></h3>
<p>In your local code, push Optimizely data to the <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">dataLayer</code> collection of GTM. In the JavaScript SDK example, you could implement the following code:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-undefined"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="javascript">JavaScript</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
dataLayer.push({
  'event': 'optimizely-decision',
  'optimizely-flagKey': decisionInfo.flagKey,
  'optimizely-ruleKey': decisionInfo.ruleKey,
  'optimizely-variationKey': decisionInfo.variationKey,
});</code></pre></div></div>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="create-user-defined-variables-in-google-tag-manager"></div><div class="heading-text">Create user-defined variables in Google Tag Manager</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Create user-defined variables in Google Tag Manager" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#create-user-defined-variables-in-google-tag-manager"></a></h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Go to <strong>Workspace > Variables > New</strong>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/a433f79-1.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter <em>Optimizely - flagKey</em> in the variable's name field.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/96acad0-2.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Variable Configuration</strong> and select <strong>Data Layer Variable</strong>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/70bee4e-3.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
<li>
<p>In the <strong>Data Layer Variable Name</strong> field, enter <em>optimizely-flagKey</em>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/055227d-4.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Repeat steps one through five to create a ruleKey and variationKey data layer variable with the following information:</p>
<div class="rdmd-table"><div class="rdmd-table-inner"><table><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Variable</th><th style="text-align:left">Variable name</th><th style="text-align:left">Data layer variable name</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left">ruleKey</td><td style="text-align:left">Optimizely - ruleKey</td><td style="text-align:left"><code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">optimizely-ruleKey</code></td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">variationKey</td><td style="text-align:left">Optimizely - variationKey</td><td style="text-align:left"><code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">optimizely-variationKey</code></td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>
</li>
</ol>
<p>When completed, you should have the following user-defined data layer variables:</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/4eba3bd-user-defined-variable.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="configure-the-configuration-tag-in-gtm"></div><div class="heading-text">Configure the configuration tag in GTM</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Configure the configuration tag in GTM" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#configure-the-configuration-tag-in-gtm"></a></h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Go to <strong>Workspace > Tags > New</strong>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/56ecd68-1-tags.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter <em>Google Analytics GA4 Configuration</em> in the name field.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Tag Configuration</strong> and select <strong>Google Analytics: GA4 Configuration</strong>.<br>
<!-- -->Enter your Measurement ID. For information on where to find your Measurement ID, refer to the <a href="https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9539598" target="" title="">GA4 documentation</a>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/133744b-3-tags.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Triggering</strong> and select <strong>Initialization - All Pages</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="configure-the-event-tag-in-gtm"></div><div class="heading-text">Configure the event tag in GTM</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Configure the event tag in GTM" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#configure-the-event-tag-in-gtm"></a></h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Go to <strong>Workspace > Tags > New</strong>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/f664e52-1-events.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter <em>Optimizely - GA4 EventUpdate</em> in the name field.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Tag Configuration</strong> and select <strong>Google Analytics: GA4 Event</strong>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/04f0823-3-events.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
</ol>
<blockquote class="callout callout_info" theme="📘"><span class="callout-icon">📘</span><h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="note-2"></div><div class="heading-text">Note</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Note" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#note-2"></a></h3><p>If you plan on creating both an Optimizely Web Experimentation experiment and a Feature Experimentation experiment, you may want to differentiate between your projects.</p><p>As a best practice, name your event: <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">optimizely-decision-fs</code> for Feature Experimentation and <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">optimizely-decision-web</code> for Web.</p><p>For instructions on setting up Optimizely Web Experimentation and GA4, review the corresponding documentation:</p><ul>
<li><a href="https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/web-experimentation/docs/integrate-google-analytics-4-ga4" target="" title="">Integration Optimizely Web Experimentation with Google Analytics 4</a></li>
<li><a href="https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/web-experimentation/docs/integrate-ga4-gtm" target="" title="">Integration Optimizely Web Experimentation with Google Analytics 4 using Google Tag Manager</a></li>
</ul></blockquote>
<ol start="4">
<li>Enter <em>optimizely-decision-fs</em> in the <strong>Event Name</strong> field.</li>
<li>Select <strong>Google Analytics GA4 Configuration</strong> in the <strong>Configuration Tag</strong> drop-down menu.</li>
<li>Expand <strong>Event Parameters</strong>.<br>
<!-- -->a) Select <strong>Add Row</strong>.<br>
<!-- -->b) Enter <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">Flag</code> in the <strong>Parameter Name</strong> field.<br>
<!-- -->c) In the <strong>Value</strong> field, select the <strong>Choose a Variable</strong> icon and select <strong>Optimizely - flagKey</strong>, which you created in Step two.<br>
<!-- -->d) Repeat steps a-c for <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">Rule</code> and <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">Variation</code>, selecting the corresponding data layer variable for each.</li>
</ol>
<p>When complete, your Tag Configuration should look like the following:</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/5c8e642-6.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<ol start="7">
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Triggering</strong> and click <strong>New Trigger (+)</strong> to create the following trigger:<br>
<!-- -->a) Enter <em>Optimizely - GA4 Trigger</em> as the trigger name.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/36a3b12-7a.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<p>b) Click <strong>Trigger Configuration</strong>, scroll down, and select <strong>Custom Event</strong>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/316eccd-7b.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<p>c) In the <strong>Event name</strong> field, enter <em>optimizely-decision-fs</em>. Click <strong>Save</strong>.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/ac020f7-7c.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<p>d) Then click <strong>Save</strong> again on the overall tag configuration page.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/76fc43c-7d.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="submit-and-publish-ga-workspace"></div><div class="heading-text">Submit and publish GA workspace</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Submit and publish GA workspace" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#submit-and-publish-ga-workspace"></a></h3>
<p>Submit and publish your workspace changes by going to <strong>Workspace >  Submit > Publish</strong> (adding any details you would like to the <strong>Submission Configuration</strong>).</p>
<p>You can then see results in GA, along with their sent values.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/a54bca7-events_in_ga.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="" class="img img-align-center border" height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/1c5d4c6-sent-values.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<p>This can be verified by viewing the <a href="https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9271392?hl=en" target="" title=""><strong>Realtime overview</strong> in the <strong>Reports</strong> tab of GA4</a>.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="without-gtm"></div><div class="heading-text">Without GTM</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Without GTM" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#without-gtm"></a></h2>
<p>You can directly push events to GA4 without using GTM, but tracking the events and variables sent by Optimizely is significantly more complicated.</p>
<p>To send Optimizely data to GA4, you use GA4’s Send events methods. For information, refer to GA4’s complete documentation on its send events methods.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/ios/events" target="" title="">iOS</a></li>
<li><a href="https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/android/events" target="" title="">Android</a></li>
<li><a href="https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/web/events" target="" title="">Web Apps</a></li>
<li><a href="https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/11147304" target="" title="">Website</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="prerequisites"></div><div class="heading-text">Prerequisites</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Prerequisites" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#prerequisites"></a></h3>
<ul>
<li>Ensure that <code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">gtag</code> is defined.</li>
<li>Ensure you have GA4 initialized and ready to interpret variables returned by Optimizely.</li>
</ul>
<p>For the JavaScript example, you would use the GA4 <a href="https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/11147304" target="" title="">send events</a> call. You would add the following sample call to your code base:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-undefined"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="javascript">JavaScript</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">gtag("event", "optimizely-decision", {
  Flag: decisionInfo.flagKey,
  Rule: decisionInfo.ruleKey,
  Variation: decisionInfo.variationKey
});</code></pre></div></div>
<p>Within GA4, you can name your variables whatever you would like. You can remove or include any variables. But for a flag rule, you should use the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">flagKey</code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">ruleKey</code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined" data-lang="">variationKey</code></li>
</ul>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="conclusion"></div><div class="heading-text">Conclusion</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Conclusion" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#conclusion"></a></h2>
<p>The next step is to create segments in GA. Segments are a subset of your analytics data. Review the <a href="/docs/create-segments-for-google-analytics-4" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="create-segments-for-google-analytics-4">Create segments for Google Analytics 4</a> console.log(decisionInfo['decisionEventDispatched']);\n    if (decisionInfo['decisionEventDispatched']) {\n      // Send data to analytics provider here\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nconst notificationId = You should use GTM to track the data and variables sent by Optimizely, as it makes timing issues much more manageable.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>GTM lets you push items to GTM’s data layer even while the integration end object is unavailable, such as the Google Analytics (GA) object. Using GTM is especially useful if you run a back-end experiment and pass that information to your front-end to send it to GA.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>Alternatively, configuring GA4 without GTM requires manually tracking the events and variables sent by Optimizely and verifying that they are sent after GA is initialized.\u003c/p>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"with-google-tag-manager\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">With Google Tag Manager\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to With Google Tag Manager\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#with-google-tag-manager\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003ch3 class=\"heading heading-3 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"push-optimizely-data-to-google-tag-manager\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Push Optimizely data to Google Tag Manager\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Push Optimizely data to Google Tag Manager\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#push-optimizely-data-to-google-tag-manager\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h3>\n\u003cp>In your local code, push Optimizely data to the \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">dataLayer\u003c/code> collection of GTM. function initNewTabEnforcer() {
  const isExternal = (href) => {
    try {
      const u = new URL(href, location.href);
      return u.origin !== location.origin;
    } catch { return false; }
  };

  const hardenAnchor = (a) => {
    if (!a || !a.href) return;
    if (!isExternal(a.href)) return;
    if (a.dataset.allowIframe != null || a.classList?.contains('allow-iframe')) return;
    a.target = '_blank';
    a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    a.__newTabBound = true;
  };

  const scan = (root) => {
    if (!root) return;
    root.querySelectorAll?.('a[href]').forEach(hardenAnchor);
    root.querySelectorAll?.('*').forEach((el) => {
      if (el.shadowRoot) {
        try { el.shadowRoot.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(hardenAnchor); } catch {}
        observe(el.shadowRoot);
      }
    });
  };

  const observe = (root) => {
    try {
      const mo = new MutationObserver(() => scan(root));
      mo.observe(root, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['href'] });
      window.__aiSearchNewTabMOs = window.__aiSearchNewTabMOs || [];
      window.__aiSearchNewTabMOs.push(mo);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[AI_SEARCH:newtab] observer error', e);
    }
  };

  const widget = document.querySelector('gen-search-widget');
  const containers = [widget, document].filter(Boolean);

  containers.forEach((c) => {
    scan(c instanceof Document ? c : (c.shadowRoot || c));
    observe(c instanceof Document ? c : (c.shadowRoot || c));
  });

  if (widget) {
    const tryLate = () => {
      scan(widget);
      if (widget.shadowRoot) scan(widget.shadowRoot);
    };
    setTimeout(tryLate, 250);
    setTimeout(tryLate, 1000);
    setTimeout(tryLate, 2000);
  }

  try { __DBG && __DBG('AI_SEARCH', 'initNewTabEnforcer attached'); } catch {}
}

// ---------------- Custom Download Spec File Button ----------------
(function () {
  /* ===== CONFIG ===== */
  const DEBUG = /\boasdebug=1\b/i.test(location.search);
  const FALLBACK_DELAY_MS = 5000;
  const log = (...a) => DEBUG && console.log('[oas-link]', ...a);

  /* ===== GUARD ===== */
  if (window.__OAS_DL_INIT__) return;
  window.__OAS_DL_INIT__ = true;

  /* ===== STATE ===== */
  const CACHE = new Map();
  let currentAbort = null;
  let runTimer     = null;
  let lastCtxKey   = null;
  let loadSeq      = 0;
  let activeCtxKey = null;
  let activeLoadId = null;
  const fbTimers   = new Map();

  /* ===== STYLES ===== */
  function ensureStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById('oas-link-style')) return;
    const s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'oas-link-style';
    s.textContent = `
      #oas-slot{margin-top:10px}
      @keyframes oasSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
      .oas-inline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:13px; color:#4b5563; }
      .oas-spin { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%;
                  border:2px solid #cbd5e1; border-top-color:#0037ff;
                  animation: oasSpin 0.8s linear infinite; }
      .oas-link-btn {
        display:inline-block;background-color:#0037ff!important;color:white!important;
        text-decoration:none!important;border:none!important;cursor:pointer!important;
        padding:10px 15px!important;font-size:14px!important;
        border-radius:5px!important;font-weight:bold!important;
      }
      #content-head.oas-loading [data-error-message="true"]{display:none!important}
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  /* ===== DOM HELPERS ===== */
  const getHead      = () => document.querySelector('#content-head');
  const getH1        = () => document.querySelector('#content-head h1');
  const getHeaderRoot = () =>
    document.querySelector('header[data-raycast-oas]') ||
    getHead()?.closest('header') ||
    document.querySelector('header');

  function getSlot() {
    ensureStyles();
    const head = getHead();
    if (!head) return null;
    let slot = head.querySelector('#oas-slot');
    if (!slot) {
      slot = document.createElement('div');
      slot.id = 'oas-slot';
      const h1 = getH1();
      if (h1) h1.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', slot);
      else head.appendChild(slot);
    }
    return slot;
  }

  function removeSlot() {
    getHead()?.querySelector('#oas-slot')?.remove();
    setHeadState(null);
  }

  function setHeadState(state) {
    getHead()?.classList.toggle('oas-loading', state === 'loading');
  }

  /* ===== RENDER ===== */
  function renderLoading(loadId) {
    const slot = getSlot();
    if (!slot) return;
    if (slot.querySelector('[data-oas-loading]')?.getAttribute('data-oas-loading') === String(loadId)) return;
    if (slot.querySelector('[data-oas-link],[data-oas-msg]')) return;
    setHeadState('loading');
    slot.innerHTML = `
      <div class="oas-inline" data-oas-loading="${loadId}" aria-live="polite">
        <span class="oas-spin" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span>Resolving API spec…</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function renderButton(result) {
    const slot = getSlot();
    if (!slot) return;
    setHeadState('ready');
    slot.innerHTML = `
      <a class="oas-link-btn" data-oas-link="true"
         href="${result.downloadUrl || result.url}"
         download="${result.filename}" rel="noopener">Download API spec</a>
    `;
  }

  function renderFallback() {
    const slot = getSlot();
    if (!slot) return;
    setHeadState('fallback');
    slot.innerHTML = `
      <div class="oas-inline" data-oas-msg="true">
        <span>Having trouble finding the proper spec? <a href="${projectRoot()}/openapi">View all API specs</a>.</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function scheduleFallback(loadId) {
    cancelFallback(loadId);
    fbTimers.set(loadId, setTimeout(() => {
      const slot = getSlot();
      const cur = slot?.querySelector('[data-oas-loading]')?.getAttribute('data-oas-loading');
      if (cur === String(loadId) && !slot.querySelector('[data-oas-link]')) renderFallback();

  }
  function cancelFallback(loadId) {
    clearTimeout(fbTimers.get(loadId));
    fbTimers.delete(loadId);
  }

  /* ===== CONTEXT ===== */
  const isInReference = () => location.pathname.includes('/reference/');
  const projectRoot   = () => location.pathname.replace(/\/reference.*/, '');
  const currentSlug   = () => (location.pathname.match(/\/reference\/([^/?#]+)/)||[])[1] || null;

  function readmeVersion() {
    const v = document.querySelector('meta[name="readme-version"]')?.content || '';
    if (!v || v === 'default') return null;
    return v.startsWith('v') ? v.slice(1) : v;
  }

  function isRealEndpoint() {
    const header = getHeaderRoot();
    if (!header) return false;
    const method = header.querySelector('[data-testid="http-method"]')?.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
    const methodOk = /^(get|post|put|patch|delete|head|options)$/.test(method);
    const hasUrl   = !!header.querySelector('[data-testid="serverurl"], [data-testid="request-url"]');
    return !!(methodOk && (hasUrl || header.hasAttribute('data-raycast-oas')));
  }

  /* ===== NETWORK ===== */
  async function headOk(url, signal) {
    try { const r = await fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD', credentials: 'include', signal }); return r.ok; }
    catch { return false; }
  }
  const absoluteUrl = (u) => { try { return new URL(u, location.origin).href; } catch { return null; } };

  /* ===== FALLBACK: name-match against /openapi index ===== */
  // Used only when data-raycast-oas is absent. Scores each listed spec by how
  // many tokens from the project root path appear in its filename, then picks
  // the best match without fetching any spec content.
  async function findFromOpenapiIndex(signal) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${projectRoot()}/openapi`, { credentials: 'include', signal });
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await res.text(), 'text/html');
      const links = [...doc.querySelectorAll('a[href$=".json"]')].map(a => a.getAttribute('href')).filter(Boolean);
      const tokens = projectRoot().replace(/^\//, '').split(/[-/]+/).filter(t => t.length > 3);
      const best = links
        .map(href => ({ href, score: tokens.reduce((s, t) => s + (href.toLowerCase().includes(t) ? 1 : 0), 0) }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0];
      if (!best || best.score === 0) return null;
      const filename = best.href.split('/').pop();
      const url = absoluteUrl(`${projectRoot()}/openapi/${filename}`);
      return url ? { url, downloadUrl: url, filename } : null;
    } catch (e) {
      log('/openapi fallback miss:', e.message);
      return null;
    }
  }

  /* ===== WAIT FOR DOM ===== */
  async function waitForHead(timeoutMs = 3000) {
    if (getHead()) return true;
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const obs = new MutationObserver(() => { if (getHead()) { obs.disconnect(); resolve(true); } });
      obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      setTimeout(() => { obs.disconnect(); resolve(!!getHead()); }, timeoutMs);
    });
  }

  /* ===== RUN ===== */
  async function run() {
    if (!isInReference()) { moHead.disconnect(); moSide.disconnect(); moHdr.disconnect(); return; }

    if (!getHead()) {
      if (!(await waitForHead(3000))) { scheduleRun('no-head-yet'); return; }
      if (!getHead()) { scheduleRun('no-head-postwait'); return; }
    }

    bindObservers();

    if (!isRealEndpoint()) { removeSlot(); scheduleRun('await-endpoint-hydration'); return; }

    const start = performance.now();
    while (!getH1() && performance.now() - start < 800) await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r));

    const ver        = readmeVersion() || 'default';
    const slug       = currentSlug() || '';
    const raycastKey = getHeaderRoot()?.getAttribute('data-raycast-oas') || '';
    const ctxKey     = `${ver}::${slug}::${raycastKey}`;
    const slot       = getSlot();

    if (activeCtxKey === ctxKey && currentAbort && !currentAbort.signal.aborted) { log('dedupe: in-flight'); return; }
    if (ctxKey === lastCtxKey && slot?.querySelector('[data-oas-link],[data-oas-msg]')) { log('skip: already rendered'); return; }
    lastCtxKey = ctxKey;

    if (CACHE.has(ctxKey)) { renderButton(CACHE.get(ctxKey)); return; }

    const myLoadId = ++loadSeq;
    activeCtxKey = ctxKey;
    activeLoadId = myLoadId;
    renderLoading(myLoadId);
    scheduleFallback(myLoadId);
    if (currentAbort) currentAbort.abort();
    currentAbort = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = currentAbort;

    try {
      // Primary: <header data-raycast-oas="..."> is ReadMe's authoritative signal
      // for exactly which spec this page was built from.
      if (raycastKey) {
        const filename   = raycastKey.split('/').pop();
        const openapiUrl = `${projectRoot()}/openapi/${filename}`;
        const url = (await headOk(openapiUrl, signal)) ? openapiUrl : absoluteUrl(raycastKey);
        if (myLoadId !== activeLoadId) return;
        if (url) { const r = { url, downloadUrl: url, filename }; cancelFallback(myLoadId); CACHE.set(ctxKey, r); renderButton(r); }
        return;
      }

      // Fallback: data-raycast-oas absent — name-match against /openapi index.
      const result = await findFromOpenapiIndex(signal);
      if (myLoadId !== activeLoadId) return;
      if (result) { cancelFallback(myLoadId); CACHE.set(ctxKey, result); renderButton(result); }
    } catch (e) {
      log('run error:', e);
    } finally {
      if (activeLoadId === myLoadId) { activeCtxKey = null; activeLoadId = null; }
    }
  }

  /* ===== LIFECYCLE ===== */
  function scheduleRun(why) {
    log('scheduleRun:', why);
    clearTimeout(runTimer);
    runTimer = setTimeout(run, 120);
  }

  const moHead = new MutationObserver((ms) => { if (ms.every(m => !m.target?.closest?.('#oas-slot'))) scheduleRun('mut:head'); });
  const moSide = new MutationObserver(() => scheduleRun('mut:sidebar'));
  const moHdr  = new MutationObserver((ms) => { if (ms.every(m => !m.target?.closest?.('#oas-slot'))) scheduleRun('mut:header'); });

  function bindObservers() {
    moHead.disconnect(); moSide.disconnect(); moHdr.disconnect();
    const head = getHead();
    if (head) moHead.observe(head, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const side = document.querySelector('#reference-sidebar');
    if (side) moSide.observe(side, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const hdr = getHeaderRoot();
    // attributes:true catches SPA updates to data-raycast-oas (attribute mutation, not childList)
    if (hdr) moHdr.observe(hdr, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-raycast-oas'] });
  }

  const onPageLoad = () => scheduleRun('pageLoad');
  if (window.jQuery && jQuery(window).on) jQuery(window).on('pageLoad', onPageLoad);
  window.addEventListener('pageLoad', onPageLoad);
  if (document.readyState === 'complete' || document.readyState === 'interactive') onPageLoad();
  else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', onPageLoad);
  bindObservers();
})();

BodyMarkdown:
Configure Google Analytics 4 (GA4)                                                           

The availability of features may depend on your plan type. Contact your Customer Success Manager if you have any questions.

For AI agents: visit https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/llms.txt for an index of all pages formatted in Markdown and endpoints in OpenAPI.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> [](#note)
> 
> This is a third-party integration and is not an Optimizely subprocessor. See Optimizely's [Third-Party Add-Ons & Platform Integration Terms](https://www.optimizely.com/legal/third-party-add-ons-platform-integration-terms/).

If you use Google Analytics to monitor your project’s traffic, you can view the results of your Optimizely experiments alongside the rest of the data that [Google Analytics](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/) collects.

## 

Configure GA4 in Feature Experimentation

[](#configure-ga4-in-feature-experimentation)

You can use a custom notification listener to configure GA4 in Optimizely Feature Experimentation. [Notification listeners](/docs/notification-listeners) let you programmatically observe and act on various events within the SDKs.

For information on how to configure a notification listener, select the corresponding SDK to view the developer documentation:

*   [Android SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-android)
*   [C# SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-csharp)
*   [Flutter SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-flutter)
*   [Go SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-go)
*   [Java SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-java)
*   [JavaScript SDK v6+](/docs/set-up-a-notification-listener-using-the-javascript-sdk-v6)
*   [JavaScript (Browser) SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-javascript) – SDK versions 5.3.5 and below
*   [JavaScript (Node) SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-javascript-node) – SDK versions 5.3.5 and below
*   [PHP SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-php)
*   [React SDK](/docs/set-up-a-notification-listener-using-the-react-sdk)
*   [React Native SDK](/docs/set-up-a-notification-listener-using-the-react-native-sdk)
*   [Ruby SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-ruby)
*   [Python SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-python)
*   [Swift SDK](/docs/set-up-notification-listener-swift)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> [](#note)
> 
> The following examples use the JavaScript (Browser) SDK.

Example `onDecision` listener.

JavaScript

    const {
      createInstance,
      createPollingProjectConfigManager,
      NOTIFICATION_TYPES
    } = require("@optimizely/optimizely-sdk");
    
    
    const projectConfigManager = createPollingProjectConfigManager({
    	sdkKey: ""
    })
    
    const optimizely = createInstance({
    	projectConfigManager
    });
    
    const onDecision = ({ type, userId, attributes, decisionInfo }) => {
      // Add a DECISION Notification Listener for type FLAG
      if (type === 'flag') {
        // Access information about feature, for example, key and enabled status
        console.log(decisionInfo['flagKey']);
        console.log(decisionInfo['enabled']);
        console.log(decisionInfo['decisionEventDispatched']);
        if (decisionInfo['decisionEventDispatched']) {
          // Send data to analytics provider here
        }
      }
    }
    
    const notificationId = optimizely.notificationCenter.addNotificationListener(
      NOTIFICATION_TYPES.DECISION,
      onDecision
    );

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> [](#note-1)
> 
> The notification listener returns the decision. It is possible to update what is returned by editing the `onDecision` notification listener. Review the [Decision notifications listeners](/docs/decision-notification-listener) developer documentation for information.

Example of a **targeted delivery** `decisionInfo` object.

![](https://files.readme.io/27a6ae2-new-targeted-delivery-decisionInfo.png)

Example of an **experiment** `decisionInfo` object.

![](https://files.readme.io/d840139-new-experiment-decisionInfo.png)

You can distinguish between a [flag delivery (targeted delivery)](/docs/run-flag-deliveries) or an experiment ([A/B test](/docs/run-a-b-tests) or [multi-armed bandit optimization](/docs/run-a-mab-optimization)) based on `decisionEventDispatched`. An experiment has this value set to `true`. A targeted delivery returns `false`, as there is no dispatched event for rollouts. See the [decision event dispatched parameter](/docs/configure-event-dispatcher-javascript) developer documentation for information.

## 

Integrate with or without Google Tag Manager

[](#integrate-with-or-without-google-tag-manager)

You can configure the integration between Optimizely and GA4 with or without Google Tag Manager (GTM). You should use GTM to track the data and variables sent by Optimizely, as it makes timing issues much more manageable.

GTM lets you push items to GTM’s data layer even while the integration end object is unavailable, such as the Google Analytics (GA) object. Using GTM is especially useful if you run a back-end experiment and pass that information to your front-end to send it to GA.

Alternatively, configuring GA4 without GTM requires manually tracking the events and variables sent by Optimizely and verifying that they are sent after GA is initialized.

## 

With Google Tag Manager

[](#with-google-tag-manager)

### 

Push Optimizely data to Google Tag Manager

[](#push-optimizely-data-to-google-tag-manager)

In your local code, push Optimizely data to the `dataLayer` collection of GTM. In the JavaScript SDK example, you could implement the following code:

JavaScript

    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    dataLayer.push({
      'event': 'optimizely-decision',
      'optimizely-flagKey': decisionInfo.flagKey,
      'optimizely-ruleKey': decisionInfo.ruleKey,
      'optimizely-variationKey': decisionInfo.variationKey,
    });

### 

Create user-defined variables in Google Tag Manager

[](#create-user-defined-variables-in-google-tag-manager)

1.  Go to **Workspace > Variables > New**.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/a433f79-1.png)
2.  Enter _Optimizely - flagKey_ in the variable's name field.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/96acad0-2.png)
3.  Click **Variable Configuration** and select **Data Layer Variable**.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/70bee4e-3.png)
4.  In the **Data Layer Variable Name** field, enter _optimizely-flagKey_.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/055227d-4.png)
5.  Click **Save**.
    
6.  Repeat steps one through five to create a ruleKey and variationKey data layer variable with the following information:
    
    Variable
    
    Variable name
    
    Data layer variable name
    
    ruleKey
    
    Optimizely - ruleKey
    
    `optimizely-ruleKey`
    
    variationKey
    
    Optimizely - variationKey
    
    `optimizely-variationKey`
    

When completed, you should have the following user-defined data layer variables:

![](https://files.readme.io/4eba3bd-user-defined-variable.png)

### 

Configure the configuration tag in GTM

[](#configure-the-configuration-tag-in-gtm)

1.  Go to **Workspace > Tags > New**.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/56ecd68-1-tags.png)
2.  Enter _Google Analytics GA4 Configuration_ in the name field.
    
3.  Click **Tag Configuration** and select **Google Analytics: GA4 Configuration**.  
    Enter your Measurement ID. For information on where to find your Measurement ID, refer to the [GA4 documentation](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9539598).
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/133744b-3-tags.png)
4.  Click **Triggering** and select **Initialization - All Pages**.
    
5.  Click **Save**.
    

### 

Configure the event tag in GTM

[](#configure-the-event-tag-in-gtm)

1.  Go to **Workspace > Tags > New**.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/f664e52-1-events.png)
2.  Enter _Optimizely - GA4 EventUpdate_ in the name field.
    
3.  Click **Tag Configuration** and select **Google Analytics: GA4 Event**.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/04f0823-3-events.png)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> [](#note-2)
> 
> If you plan on creating both an Optimizely Web Experimentation experiment and a Feature Experimentation experiment, you may want to differentiate between your projects.
> 
> As a best practice, name your event: `optimizely-decision-fs` for Feature Experimentation and `optimizely-decision-web` for Web.
> 
> For instructions on setting up Optimizely Web Experimentation and GA4, review the corresponding documentation:
> 
> *   [Integration Optimizely Web Experimentation with Google Analytics 4](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/web-experimentation/docs/integrate-google-analytics-4-ga4)
> *   [Integration Optimizely Web Experimentation with Google Analytics 4 using Google Tag Manager](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/web-experimentation/docs/integrate-ga4-gtm)

4.  Enter _optimizely-decision-fs_ in the **Event Name** field.
5.  Select **Google Analytics GA4 Configuration** in the **Configuration Tag** drop-down menu.
6.  Expand **Event Parameters**.  
    a) Select **Add Row**.  
    b) Enter `Flag` in the **Parameter Name** field.  
    c) In the **Value** field, select the **Choose a Variable** icon and select **Optimizely - flagKey**, which you created in Step two.  
    d) Repeat steps a-c for `Rule` and `Variation`, selecting the corresponding data layer variable for each.

When complete, your Tag Configuration should look like the following:

![](https://files.readme.io/5c8e642-6.png)

7.  Click **Triggering** and click **New Trigger (+)** to create the following trigger:  
    a) Enter _Optimizely - GA4 Trigger_ as the trigger name.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/36a3b12-7a.png)
    
    b) Click **Trigger Configuration**, scroll down, and select **Custom Event**.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/316eccd-7b.png)
    
    c) In the **Event name** field, enter _optimizely-decision-fs_. Click **Save**.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/ac020f7-7c.png)
    
    d) Then click **Save** again on the overall tag configuration page.
    
    ![](https://files.readme.io/76fc43c-7d.png)

### 

Submit and publish GA workspace

[](#submit-and-publish-ga-workspace)

Submit and publish your workspace changes by going to **Workspace > Submit > Publish** (adding any details you would like to the **Submission Configuration**).

You can then see results in GA, along with their sent values.

![](https://files.readme.io/a54bca7-events_in_ga.png) ![](https://files.readme.io/1c5d4c6-sent-values.png)

This can be verified by viewing the [**Realtime overview** in the **Reports** tab of GA4](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9271392?hl=en).

## 

Without GTM

[](#without-gtm)

You can directly push events to GA4 without using GTM, but tracking the events and variables sent by Optimizely is significantly more complicated.

To send Optimizely data to GA4, you use GA4’s Send events methods. For information, refer to GA4’s complete documentation on its send events methods.

*   [iOS](https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/ios/events)
*   [Android](https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/android/events)
*   [Web Apps](https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/web/events)
*   [Website](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/11147304)

### 

Prerequisites

[](#prerequisites)

*   Ensure that `gtag` is defined.
*   Ensure you have GA4 initialized and ready to interpret variables returned by Optimizely.

For the JavaScript example, you would use the GA4 [send events](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/11147304) call. You would add the following sample call to your code base:

JavaScript

    gtag("event", "optimizely-decision", {
      Flag: decisionInfo.flagKey,
      Rule: decisionInfo.ruleKey,
      Variation: decisionInfo.variationKey
    });

Within GA4, you can name your variables whatever you would like. You can remove or include any variables. But for a flag rule, you should use the following:

*   `flagKey`
*   `ruleKey`
*   `variationKey`

## 

Conclusion

[](#conclusion)

The next step is to create segments in GA. Segments are a subset of your analytics data. Review the [Create segments for Google Analytics 4](/docs/create-segments-for-google-analytics-4) documentation for complete instructions.
